name: node-add-refuses-existing
body: `apg node add <layer> <type> <name> …` must refuse when the node FQN already exists, with an error naming the entity and the correct follow-up (`apg node update` to change it, or `apg node rm` to remove it). Today `node_add` (src/node_cmd.rs:62–84) constructs a bare NodeFile and calls `layers::write_project`, whose validation explicitly exempts an overwritten FQN from the uniqueness universe (validate_change, layers.rs:1757) — so a re-add full-replaces the file and silently drops every out/in edge. Acceptance: re-adding an existing FQN exits non-zero, no file is written, and the pre-existing node's edges are untouched.
